Coverage links the assault to Ukraine's Patriot interceptor shortage, with Zelenskyy calling on allies to replenish stockpiles. Ukraine is also seeking Elon Musk's help to deploy Starlink-equipped drones capable of striking Russian missile launchers up to 200km inside Russia. Poland's military activated preventive aviation and defensive measures, and Zelenskyy faces domestic political pressure. A related thread on Russia's strained oil industry has developed further: Ukrainian strikes have knocked out nearly a third of Russia's major refineries, sparking fuel shortages, petrol station fights, and arrests of complaining citizens. This remains separate from other Russia-linked threads: bank withdrawals fearing state seizure; Kanye West's sold-out Russian shows; Russia's UK embassy threatening consequences over British drone use; and Ukrainian drones destroying Wildberries warehouses with Putin's pledge of support.

clusters.state_of_play: Hayden Panettiere died at 36 in Greenville, South Carolina, found in cardiac arrest from a suspected overdose at an Airbnb after Brian Hickerson administered Narcan; the DEA has reportedly joined the investigation. New reporting reveals Hickerson was called out in court over alleged drug use just three days before her death, and that Panettiere had traveled to South Carolina with him only a day earlier. A protective order Panettiere filed against Hickerson six years before her death details abuse including hair-pulling and spitting, and further accounts describe multiple prior arrests for his abuse. Zach Hickerson has given a direct account of finding her unconscious and administering Narcan.
